'''Boar Benu''' was a resistance leader after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] became Darth Vader. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], he perished during a meeting of resistance leaders on the [[Jedi asteroid|secret asteroid]] that [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Trever Flume]] set up together with others as a secret base for planning operations against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
